mods.name: mlog-assertions-8
mods.author: cardillan
mods.description:
This mod aims to make debugging in Mindustry Logic a bit easier:[[]lightgray]

Enhanced [[]accent]Vars[[]] screen: full precision values, sorting and filtering variables, copying variables to the clipboard.

[[]accent]Memory[[]] screen for inspecting contents of memory blocks, using the same interface as the [[]accent]Vars[[]] screen.

Settings for overriding instruction limit, by up to 1000 instructions, to make space for additional debugging code.

[[]accent]Snapshots[[]] allow saving, reviewing and restoring the state of logic processors, memory blocks and other entities.

A [[]accent]profiler[[]] for gathering statistics about program execution.

Custom mlog instructions for performing runtime checks, logging messages, reporting errors, triggering a bbreakpoint, taking snaphots and managing profiling.

Visual indication of stopped processors, processors executing a [[]accent]wait[[]] instruction, and failed runtime checks, directly on the map.

[[]white]Using this mod on maps with lots of processors may impact the game's performance.[[]]

See the [[]accent]README.md[[]] file in the mod's GitHub repository for more information.

mods.name: fluxweave
mods.author: Ranii
mods.description:
Touching blocks work together as one; drills/pumps/factories/generators/reactors. A single input or output serves the whole line.

v1.10.0 - Balance update
Drill and pump capacities lowered from 150 to their vanilla values (e.g. pneumatic drill = 10) to keep them balanced.

v1.9.1 - Hotfix
Fixed long chains of factories (more than 5) not fully emptying through a single output. Products now drain toward the factory touching an output, so the far end empties too. If the output is removed or blocked for a while, the chain spreads evenly again and recovers when another output line is connected. One output line can only carry so much, so use a faster line if a chain backs up.

v1.9
Reactors: touching reactors balance their coolant, so one conduit feeds the whole row. Fuel is never moved.
Factories: touching factories of the same type share inputs and outputs, so one pipe, conveyor and output line serve a whole row.
Drills: boost liquid like water is now shared along the chain.
Fixed a crash on Android and drills' outputs getting stuck next to walls.

v1.11.0
Turrets: touching turrets of the same type share coolant, so one conduit cools a whole arsenal of turrets, except ammo, they still need seperate ammo inputs.
Conveyors can now pass items through any drill in a chain, and those items flow to the chain's exit.
